text:
I had my dental implants done with Dr. Panumas about 2-3 years ago. Most recently, I went in today to have a replacement implant adjusted because it was slightly spaced out, allowing food to easily get trapped. Dr. Panumas replaced the implant free of charge, without any additional fees.

The clinic is clean and located in the M Tower office building. The rooms are spacious and comfortable.

I highly recommend this clinic to anyone reading this review. It's a one-time payment with excellent after-sales service. Plus, it's run by a single doctor who is a highly qualified medical professor, and they use the latest X-ray equipment. There are no hidden extra charges.

If you're interested, you can try calling Dr. Panumas directly. She's very kind and gives great advice.
